title: Measures, tables or columns use inconsistent naming conventions
rationale: Consistent naming reduces authoring friction and maintenance cost.
review_note: Legacy/source naming may be intentionally preserved.

title: Technical fields visible to report authors without a clear need
rationale: Hiding keys and technical columns improves self-service usability.
review_note: Fields may need visibility for advanced authors or troubleshooting.

title: Business-critical measures lack descriptions or documentation
rationale: Descriptions improve governance, handover and discoverability.
review_note: Small single-owner models may rely on external documentation.

title: Orphaned/unused measures or calculated objects remain in model
rationale: Unused objects increase clutter and maintenance overhead.
review_note: Objects may support external reports, Analyze in Excel or future work.

title: No clear display folders or semantic organization in a measure-heavy model
rationale: Display folders can improve discoverability when many measures exist.

title: Hard-coded environment/source settings reduce portability
rationale: Parameters or environment-aware configuration make deployment and maintenance safer.
evidence_required: Power Query source strings and parameters
review_note: Single-environment personal reports may not need portability.

title: RLS/security design is undocumented or overly complex
rationale: Security logic should be understandable, testable and maintainable.
review_note: Complex security can be valid; requires explicit test evidence.

title: No ownership or refresh/support information for business-critical report
rationale: Operational ownership is part of maintainable BI delivery.
review_note: Personal/ad-hoc reports may not need formal ownership.
